# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH LEGIONELLA PNEUMOPHILA

Intravenous therapy preferred initially until signs and symptoms improve.

# Duration of therapy

Treat for 7 to 10 days based on response. Consider longer courses of therapy in

immunocompromised patients with severe illness. ID consultation is recommended

if immunocompromise.

# Recommend starting with parenteral therapy

[Azithromycin 500 mg IV q24h M](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)

< OR >

[Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q24h R,DI](psjizid-levofloxacin-750mg-iv-q24h)

# Switch to oral to complete therapy

[Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h M](psjzid-azithromycin-500mg-po-q24h)

< OR >

[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h R,DI](psjzid-levofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h)
